name: microsandbox
description: Self-hosted, local-first microVM sandboxes with OCI image compatibility.
descriptionZh: 自托管、local-first 的 microVM 沙箱，兼容 OCI 镜像。
keyFact: microsandbox is an Apache-2.0, local-first microVM runtime that gives each workload its own guest Linux kernel and starts in under 100-200ms, with OCI image compatibility and SDKs for Rust, Python, TypeScript and Go; it runs on Linux via KVM, Apple Silicon and Windows via WHP.
keyFactZh: microsandbox 是 Apache-2.0、local-first 的 microVM 运行时，为每个工作负载提供独立 guest Linux 内核，启动低于 100-200ms，兼容 OCI 镜像并提供 Rust、Python、TypeScript、Go SDK；在 Linux 上走 KVM，Apple Silicon 与 Windows 上走 WHP。
caveatZh: 核验时标注为 beta/experimental 阶段。
